turns.question: Which customer country brought in the most revenue per buying customer in September 2026, and how much per customer?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no revenue-per-customer metric, so I can't give a per-customer figure or rank countries on it; the closest metrics are Revenue (EUR) and Active customers (distinct customers with a non-cancelled order), which for 1-30 September 2026 by customer country were DE EUR 2,665.50 from 2 active customers, GB EUR 2,634.00 from 2, TR EUR 2,412.00 from 2, NL EUR 2,408.00 from 2, FR EUR 1,241.00 from 1 and US EUR 1,222.25 from 1 (Average order value (EUR) is per order, not per customer). Late: sales.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
